注意の瞬き: Headword correction for one unchanged concept (attentional blink). The first-pass label 注意瞬脱 / ちゅういしゅんだつ has inadequate Japanese academic support and is the established Chinese research term; 注意の瞬き / ちゅういのまばたき is positively attested in Japanese research (日本認知心理学会 2007 on J-STAGE; reading given as 「注意の瞬き（まばたき）」 in 知能と情報 34(2)). Only term, reading, form and the single passage occurrence change.
オープンモニタリング瞑想: Headword correction for one unchanged concept (open monitoring meditation). The first-pass label 開放監視瞑想 / かいほうかんしめいそう has inadequate Japanese academic support; オープンモニタリング瞑想 is the name a Kyoto University investigator uses in experimental methods (KAKEN 24650135 final report, 「オープンモニタリング瞑想（OM条件）」). Only term, reading, form and the single passage occurrence change.
裸形: Editorial headword normalization for one unchanged concept. 裸形修行 / らぎょうしゅぎょう is an intelligible compositional phrase whose standing as an established lexical item was not demonstrated; 裸形 / らぎょう is a documented lexical headword (University of Tsukuba learner dictionary; used for Jain non-possession in a 佛教大学 doctoral dissertation). Term, reading, form, meaning, defJa, the target clause and tipJa change; the Digambara account is unchanged.
戒名: The English meaning "posthumous Buddhist name" states the misconception that the card's own passage, defJa and tip correct (the name may be received during life). meaning becomes "Buddhist precept name"; nothing else changes.
安心立命: English sentence 2 romanized the headword as Anjin-ryumyo, the Buddhist reading あんじんりゅうみょう, which disagrees with the reading this card teaches (あんしんりつめい). The romanization becomes Anshin-ritsumei; the reading and everything else are unchanged.
実相: English sentence 2 rendered the headword as "Suchness", the English this deck uses for 真如, and disagreed with the card's own meaning "the true aspect of reality". Sentence 2 now says "The true aspect of things"; nothing else changes.
虚無: defJa and sense gave the nihilistic sense (everything feels meaningless) while the passage and tip use plain nothingness contrasted with Buddhist emptiness. defJa and sense now give the plain-nothingness sense; passage, tip and English are unchanged.
